summary: The recurring repository-escape class is consolidated behind one shared, well-documented resolved-path boundary check that init, adopt and upgrade all route every write through. A file-destination variant handles copy2's directory-container and symlink-follow semantics; a single guarded_copytree wrapper preflights every tree-copy leaf; and an AST-based anti-reopen scan enforces the invariant across all three modules so the class cannot silently reopen. Command-level preflights give clean abort before the first mutation.
